launcher.title: Start recording stock
launcher.description: Start a new stock recording. Your progress stays available while you move between the recording steps.

help.stock: Enter the receiving details for this stock. You can return to this step while the recording is in progress.
help.batch: Name this batch. You can return here before the stock is saved.
help.products: Add a new product only if it does not already exist in your available products. You can skip this step and use existing products while recording.
help.method: Choose whether this batch will be recorded item by item or through groups. Earlier steps stay available while you record.
help.individual: Record one physical item at a time. Each entered item stays in the current recording until you review and save.
help.group: Name the group, choose whether it is recorded by quantity or by individual items, then continue inside that group.
help.review: Check what has been recorded. Save a draft or finish and receive the stock.

recordMethodHelp.individual: Enter each physical item one by one.
recordMethodHelp.group: Create one or more groups and record each group by quantity or by individual items.

groupMethodHelp.quantity: Record product quantities inside this group.
groupMethodHelp.individual: Record each physical item inside this group one by one.

validation.groupRequired: Add at least one group to the batch.
validation.groupBalance: Product quantities must equal the group quantity.
validation.individualWhole: Individually tracked stock must use a whole quantity.
validation.individualCount: Record all {count} individual items before receiving this stock.
validation.productUnitMismatch: This SKU uses a different unit. Choose a product with the same unit as this group.
validation.stockExpenses: Enter a valid stock expense amount.
validation.recordMethod: Choose how you want to record this stock.
validation.quantityPositive: Enter a quantity greater than zero.
validation.wholeQuantity: {unit} is a countable unit. Enter a whole quantity.
validation.individualOneAtATime: Individual recording saves one physical item at a time.
validation.groupUnitMismatch: Products in this group must use the same unit: {unit}.
validation.groupNeedsProduct: Enter at least one product before finishing this group.
